title_zh: 为虚构国家时间线分开标注三个事件

scenario.label_zh: 为虚构国家时间线分开标注三个事件
scenario.goal_zh: 区分政变、执政党变化与宪法通过，并约定删除未经资料证实的先后推论

context_zh: 历史写作课堂使用完全虚构的国家材料，材料说明政变、政党及宪法事件的不同时间。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Leo
sentences.text: My timeline says the coup immediately created a communist government.

sentences.speaker: Tutor
sentences.text: Does the source say that? The account of the coup only describes officers removing the president.

sentences.speaker: Leo
sentences.text: The next page says the communist party entered government two years later. I joined the events together.

sentences.speaker: Tutor
sentences.text: And where does the new constitution fit?

sentences.speaker: Leo
sentences.text: It was approved the following year. A separate note calls that a constitutional change, not another military takeover.

sentences.speaker: Tutor
sentences.text: Then give each event its own date. What will you do with the claim about an immediate change of government?

sentences.speaker: Leo
sentences.text: I'll remove that claim and use three separate entries, each linked to the page that supports it.
